summary: Iteration 3 - Comprehensive testing of all critical fixes: AdminProtection API_URL fix, analytics endpoints, admin CRUD (tools/blogs/categories), toast notifications, user blog create/edit with tags array. 16/16 backend tests passed. Found and fixed 4 frontend bugs.

minor.issue: Returns 403 instead of 401 when no token provided. Likely IP whitelist middleware fires before auth middleware. Test updated to accept 401 or 403.

ui_bugs.issue: showToast function was defined INSIDE handleBulkUpload try block (line 758), making it scoped only to that function. All other functions (handleToolSubmit, deleteHandler, etc.) got ReferenceError: showToast is not defined when saving/deleting tools.
Called getCurrentUser() which is not imported (only getUserData is imported). Caused Error loading authors. FIXED: changed to getUserData()

Called getCurrentUser() inside openBlogModal else branch (line 436), causing modal to never open for new blog creation (ReferenceError thrown before modal.classList.remove('hidden')). FIXED: changed to getUserData()
Called superAdminApi.users.getAll({ limit: 1000 }) but backend enforces le=200 max, causing 422 Unprocessable Entity. FIXED: changed to limit: 200

issues: confirm() dialogs still used for publish/unpublish/delete actions (showToast was replaced but confirm dialogs remain). These are acceptable UX but could be replaced with modal confirmations for consistency.

bug1_tools_showToast_scope.root_cause: In tools.astro, showToast function was accidentally placed inside the try{} block of handleBulkUpload (lines 749-765). This scoped it to only be available within handleBulkUpload, causing all other functions (handleToolSubmit, deleteHandler, handleBulkAssign) to get ReferenceError when trying to call showToast.
bug1_tools_showToast_scope.impact: Tool save/update/delete operations would succeed but show no toast notification - silently failed feedback. Error path showed 'Error saving tool: ReferenceError: showToast is not defined' in console.
bug1_tools_showToast_scope.fix: Moved showToast function to module scope, before handleBulkUpload function definition.

bug2_blogs_getCurrentUser.root_cause: blogs.astro imported { requireAdmin, getUserData } from auth utilities but called getCurrentUser() (non-existent) in two places: loadAuthors() for pre-selecting current author, and openBlogModal() for new blog author pre-selection.
bug2_blogs_getCurrentUser.impact: 1) loadAuthors() caught the error silently, 2) openBlogModal() threw UNCAUGHT error before removing 'hidden' class from modal, so 'Add New Blog' button appeared to do nothing.
bug2_blogs_getCurrentUser.fix: Changed all getCurrentUser() calls to getUserData()

bug3_blogs_limit_422.root_cause: blogs.astro called superAdminApi.users.getAll({ limit: 1000 }) to load authors list, but backend /api/superadmin/users has Query constraint le=200 (limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=200)).
bug3_blogs_limit_422.impact: 422 Unprocessable Entity error on authors load. Authors dropdown empty, current user not pre-selected.
